title: While MettleUp has paused a gym, its desk can still add body measurements, diet plans and member photos, and members still get pop-ups for them
what: Pausing a gym is meant to make it read-only: members, plans, receipts, messages, timings, challenges and the staff list all refuse changes. Body measurements, diet plans and member photos were added later without that lock, and their save steps do not check the pause either. So a paused gym keeps saving new measurements and diet plans, members get a phone pop-up for each one, and photos can be added or changed.
expected: A paused gym's measurement, diet plan and photo saves are refused the same way as its other records, while reading and removing stay allowed.
how_often: every save while a gym is paused
fix_line: Add the same paused-gym lock to the measurement, diet plan and member photo records

title: Once the plan lock is on, members of a gym that stopped paying still see the shop and offers, and their orders fail
what: The member app decides which Pro extras to show only from the gym's plan name (Pro, Starter). It never learns that the gym is in its basic or read-only stage after not paying. The server, in those stages, refuses every Pro extra, so a member of a lapsed Pro gym still sees the shop and places an order that is refused with a plan error.
expected: The member app is told the gym's stage as well as its plan, and hides or explains the Pro extras the server will refuse.
how_often: every time, once the plan lock is switched on, for a gym past its grace week
fix_line: Send the gym stage with the pack to the member app and close Pro extras on it

title: A new challenge pops up on every member's phone even when the gym already sent two messages that day
what: Gym messages are kept calm: from the 3rd message of the day, members get no phone pop-up. A new challenge sends its own pop-up to every member with pop-ups on, through a separate path that never looks at how many messages went out that day, and is not counted for the next message either.
expected: Pop-ups that go to every member, like a new challenge, follow the same 2-a-day rule as gym messages and count toward it.
how_often: a day with two messages and a new challenge
fix_line: Count gym-wide challenge pop-ups in the daily calm rule
